scenarios.title: Browser smoke test successfully loads the application in Chromium
given: the application is available for testing
Playwright is configured to run tests using Chromium
scenarios.when: the browser smoke test is executed against the application
then: a Chromium browser instance launches and navigates to the application entry point (e.g. /)
the application page loads and renders successfully

scenarios.title: Treegress e2e-playwright runner starts application and executes browser tests
given: the e2e-playwright runner is registered with Treegress
the repository is configured to start the web application during test execution
then: the web application is automatically started
the browser test suite is run against the active application
the runner reports successful test completion

scenarios.title: CI workflow installs Chromium and executes the e2e-playwright runner
given: the continuous integration pipeline is configured for browser testing
scenarios.when: the CI pipeline runs the browser test job
then: Chromium and necessary browser dependencies are installed in the environment
the e2e-playwright runner executes within CI
the CI test job completes with a passing status

scenarios.title: Runner reports failure when a browser smoke test assertion fails
given: a browser test encounters an assertion mismatch or application failure
then: the runner reports the specific test failure
the runner exits with a non-zero failure status

scenarios.title: Runner reports an error when the application server fails to start
given: the application server fails to start or does not become ready within the timeout period
then: the runner detects that the application server is unavailable
the runner terminates and reports a failure indicating the web server failed to start
